manual_action: Use Windows Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files or Disk Cleanup as Administrator.
Run `dotnet nuget locals all --clear` only if package re-download is acceptable.
Run `python -m pip cache purge` if Python package downloads can be re-fetched.
Remove stale WinGet installer cache after confirming no winget install is running.
Review Recycle Bin contents manually before emptying.
Close running installers/apps, then remove stale files from the user temp folder or use Windows Storage cleanup.
Use Windows Delivery Optimization cleanup through system Storage settings.
